folds.heading: ## Later W1–W4 delivery reconciled, 2026-11-04 (B81)
folds.body: The [checkpoint’s completed final gate](CHECKPOINT.md#completed-final-gate) supersedes this initial missing-join map at the selected scope. Its actual content records W1’s two material preparations, earned fitting and precise results; W2’s earned office, funded delegation and successor-reviewed handover; W3’s two retained historical origins with present ownership/observer/brace consumer; and W4’s ambient versus paid-dose intake, committed reserve and practiced quality. Historical stock/XP/opening fixtures remain declared. The final isolated candidate records its own rebuild, full suite, desktop matrix and ten literal persistence states after primary-source drift and fixture failures. Current selected lore validation also recognizes a narrow Mistglass world.initialize receipt and retained per-world histories, so “Village/P3/P4 only” is not a current universal absence claim. That source observation and this receipt reading do not refresh current gameplay/input parity. Actual body replacement stayed source-test coverage; foreign-world inertness had native proof. Old reservations, preview address, test wrapper and one-realm milestone are history. Current AD36/AD42/AD43 and desktop authority govern new claims; no new W implementation or app adoption is selected.

folds.heading: ## Later authority and historical reservations, 2026-11-04 (B81)
folds.body: This October 12 map preserves its source offsets, compiler/source versions, paused-owner and isolated-candidate observations. Later [finite world closure](../../cross-audit-reconciliation-2026-10-15/CLOSURE_RETURN_WORLDS.md) records resumption/ended candidate and stage-specific successors; neither an old pause nor candidate proof becomes today’s writer reservation or current combined gameplay. Keep its useful source → proposal → actual owner/consumer → atomic cursor/material settlement → observer-safe presentation distinctions. The selected Lin/staff service is not a region-wide economy or autonomous population simulator, and the reported Ink binding gap needs current source before being called absent now. Current USER_VISION/rule owners govern product authority; reversible authorized tuning need not become a human sign-off gate, and AD42 makes feel review optional. The current content request authorizes reconciliation, not an old paused runtime goal, stale dispatcher or automatic new integration wave (AD32/AD36).
